description: Addresses the team audit knows (X Layer, chain 196). The IGNIX and DEX addresses are fixed. 'other' maps a label to the address of any further contract the team calls, so that calls to it are not listed as unknown targets: the OKX.AI agent registry, and TapeOut's three DeWEB contracts, to which the deployer publishes the site (tools/deweb; the transactions are listed in deployments/xlayer.json under site.txs).

covenant.comment: The Covenant contracts on X Layer mainnet. They are recorded in deployments/xlayer.json by the signing sessions; pass that file with --deployment deployments/xlayer.json and every null below is filled in from it (an address named in both places must be the same). They stay null here so that one file, written from the chain, is the only record. The deployer deploys every contract and is entry 0 of the TeamRegistry; the deployer and the keeper are always audited. transistors and circuits are the processor the Splitter created; kernelFactoryV2 and lensV2 are kernel v2 (USD₮0 quote, deploy/launch-kernel-v2.sh); kernels lists kernels beyond the deployment's flagships (the audit also asks both KernelFactories).

entryPoints.comment: ERC-4337 EntryPoints (canonical deployments, both with code on X Layer). For a team wallet that is a smart wallet, the audit scans their UserOperationEvent logs (sender = the wallet) from the wallet's first activity to the audit block, and audits each user operation like a transaction.

smartWalletImplementations.comment: EIP-7702 delegates that are known smart-wallet implementations. A team wallet whose code is exactly 0xef0100 followed by one of these addresses is a smart wallet: listed, not flagged, and its user operations are audited. Any other code, or a delegation to an address not listed here, is flagged.
